values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/littlewolflake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Little Wolf State Forest Campground, Montmorency: 24 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in boat access only (amenity table: 'C', not a ramp).

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/littlewolflake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.'; amenity table: Boat ramp(R) OR carry-in access(C) 'C'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/littlewolflake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table (Little Wolf State Forest Campground: 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 24 sites for tent, small trailer and large trailer use (no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/littlewolflake ('There are 24 sites for tent, small trailer and large trailer use.'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (24 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on Little Wolf Lake, 3 mi SE of Lewiston via County Road 489 and Wolf Lake Road (Montmorency County); managed by Otsego Lake State Park. Panfish in the lake; East Twin Lake is a mile northwest. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 24 sites for tent/small/large trailers (confirmed), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed). Cleared max_rig_ft 35 (derived from the note's 'up to 35-ft trailers', which no DNR page states). Boat access is carry-in only per the amenity table, so the note's 'Boat ramp on the lake' was dropped. Season (closed Nov 1 - April 15) already manual and matches. The page says the campground 'is located on Little Wolf Lake' (DNR water-access boilerplate; entry 'lakeview', not flagged). Not equestrian (type 'rustic'). Note trimmed of field restatements.
